name: net
assumes: a net other than NC, after DNS parts are left out (unless include_dns) and test point pins are set aside: a test point does not drive or load the net in the product
push_pull counts pins of type output

rail is the supply pins on the net: power is an undirected supply pin (a supply input or output, direction unknown), power_out a supply output; power_in is a supply input and counts under sinks, not here. power_out beside power counts as power_out

other is open when any open_collector or open_emitter pin is present; otherwise bus when any bidirectional or tristate pin is present; otherwise other when any passive, unspecified, free or untyped pin is present (it may drive, or its direction is unknown); otherwise none. A no_connect pin neither drives nor loads
sinks is some when any input or power_in pin is present
